intro_html: Long hut approach that leads from the lush green Tierfehd to the high alpine glacier world around the Planura Hut SAC. With the alpine taxi to Hintersand, the walking time can be shortened by about one and a half hours.

getting_there.by_pt_html:
Zug to Linthal.

You can get from Linthal to Tierfehd with Alpentaxi Vollenweider 079 /770 34 86 alpentaxi@taxivollenweider.ch http://www.alpentaxi.ch
getting_there.by_car_html: Drive to Linthal / Tierfehd via the A3 motorway (exit Niederurnen) through the Linth valley. Parking at Tierfehd (end of road, ~806 m). The Linth valley road ends here.

day_plans.title: Day 1
rows: Depart Tierfehd (806 m); follow valley trail south
Hinter Sand (~1300 m) — valley narrows, steeper terrain
Ober Sand (~1800 m) — alpine zone, views open up
Above 2400 m — rocky terrain, possible snow patches
Arrive Planurahütte SAC (2947 m); check in, lunch, rest
Explore area or begin descent (if day trip)
Return to Tierfehd (if descending same day)

lapse_rate.example_html: Example: Linthal forecast 15–25 °C → hut ≈ +1 °C to +11 °C. At 2947 m expect glacier wind and rapid temperature drops.

weather.season_html: Late June–September when the hut is staffed and the trail is snow-free. The upper section above Ober Sand holds snow into July. Check hut website for current conditions.

takeaways_html: The long approach from Tierfehd (2100+ m gain) is physically very demanding and requires good fitness; many hikers use bikes or the alpine taxi to Hinter Sand to shorten the lower valley section.
The upper route above Ober Sand enters exposed rocky terrain with fixed chains around 2800 m; snow patches persist well into July.
The Planurahütte (renovated 2012, highest SAC hut in eastern Switzerland) offers a dramatic glacier setting and serves as the base for Tödi, Clariden, and glacier traverses.

reports.title: Von Tierfehd zur Planurahütte 2947müM und zurück
bullets_html: Full out-and-back from Tierfehd; describes the approach as conditioning-demanding but beautiful and worthwhile.
Encountered a heavy thunderstorm at the hut during dinner, followed by an atmospheric sunset — underscores rapid weather changes at this altitude.
35 photos documenting the entire route from valley floor to glacier world.

reports.title: bike and hike planurahütte
bullets_html: Used a bike from Schwändi via Tierfehd to Hinter Sand — steep but rideable — then hiked to the hut.
Describes the Planurahütte at 2947 m as beautifully situated in the glacier landscape.

reports.title: Hüfihütte - Planurahütte - Claridenhütte
bullets_html: Multi-day hut-to-hut traverse connecting Hüfihütte, Planurahütte, and Claridenhütte.
Notes a large wind shelter (Windkolk) northeast of the hut before the final steep section.
Roped glacier crossing of the Claridenfirn required; warns of hidden crevasses as snow softens.

safety_html: SAC grade T3+ — check conditions before departure.
Turn back if thunderstorms develop — lightning risk above treeline is extreme.
